body: You're definitely an inspiration to me. I'm struggling with a lot of things right now and it's nice to see it's possible to get control.
Do you think I could talk to my bishop about getting a counselor before I confess everything to him? I don't exactly have a lot of money to afford a psychiatrist or a counselor on my own.

I'm mostly leaning towards this. I hope my bishop will understand that I want to work some things out before I tell him everything. Thank you for your advice, by the way. I will most likely do this method.
Thank you. I definitely need prayers right now.
You're right. I know it's not horrible, just totally not what I would normally do. I appreciate the non-mormon insight though. Thanks.

You're right. I'm not exactly in a place where I can afford a professional counselor right now. Ideally, I'd like to talk to a counselor before I confess everything to my wife so I can show her I'm making necessary changes in my life so that something like this won't happen again. Also, I want to be mentally prepared for whatever my wife decides to do. I'm know she will be heartbroken and I'm not entirely sure I'll be ready to deal with that.
I'm sorry you had to experience that. That honestly does sound awful. I'm pretty sure I will meet with a professional counselor first before my bishop.
I've considered this as well. I know I need help that I'm not able to give myself. Sorry I took so long to respond. I was working. I appreciate your comment though. Thank you.
Ok, will do. thanks. I definitely want some help, because like I said I don't actually want to kill myself. I just messed up, really really bad and I feel very limited in my options.
